connections.why: Market structures and demand and supply underpin how firms behave and set output
Microeconomic market failures motivate the government policies studied at the macro level
Domestic macroeconomic performance and policy are extended to the international economy
Firm behaviour and labour markets scale up to global firms, trade and development
The same demand, supply and market-failure tools analyse global markets
Macroeconomic conditions shape the costs, revenues and decisions firms face
